_comment: Quests (Quests.java): what someone says when they ask something of a player, and after. {player} is what it calls you, {what} the goods and how many ('16 iron ingots'), {thing} the goods alone ('iron ingots'), {enemy} who its town is at war with, {town} its town (or, carrying word, the town it's for), {who} who word is for (or from), {dead} whose grave, {pay} a whole clause about the pay ('the town will pay 60 silver', 'the till's empty but we won't forget it', 'i'll pay 30 silver when you're back', 'i cant pay but id owe you one').

any: {player}, we're at war with {enemy} and running out of {thing}. could you bring {what}? {pay}
this war with {enemy} is eating through our {thing}. can you get us {what}? {pay}
{player} we need {what} for the fight with {enemy}. {pay}. can you do it?
we're short of {thing} and {enemy} isnt letting up. {what} would keep us going. {pay}. will you?
hey {player}. {town} needs {what} while this war's on. {pay}. you in?
cant hold off {enemy} without {thing}. could you bring {what}? {pay}

we need {thing} badly, {enemy} is at our throats. {what}, can you manage that? {pay}
